steps.text: The save holds word 1 with only bit 1 set, the reward not yet taken, and word 41 empty.
calc: progression A4: each word is written as it stands at Save and Exit; the file holds word 1 = 0x0002 and word 41 = 0x0000.
progression A: bit 1 = done in a game, reward not yet taken.

steps.text: Loading clears bits 13 and 14 of each word of quests 0 to 41 and sets bit 15 when bit 1 is set, so word 1 gains bit 15.
calc: progression A3: w = saved word; clear bits 13 and 14; if bit 1 of w: set bit 15 of w.

steps.text: Akara's reward message, with bit 1 of word 1 set, sets bit 0 of word 1, done.
calc: progression D7: the reward message with bit 1 set sets bit 0 and clears bit 1; word 1's reward also clears the log steps.

steps.text: The same message clears bit 1 of word 1, the reward pending.
calc: progression D7: the reward message with bit 1 set sets bit 0 and clears bit 1; word 1's reward also clears the log steps.

steps.text: The same message sets bit 13 of word 41, with bit 1 the offer of a free skill reset in Hell.
calc: progression word 41: the same message sets bits 13 and 1 of word 41.

steps.text: The same message sets bit 1 of word 41, with bit 13 the offer of a free skill reset in Hell.
calc: progression word 41: the same message sets bits 13 and 1 of word 41.

steps.text: The same message ends with ClearSteps on word 1, which clears its bits 2 to 11, the log steps; no step bit was set here, so the word does not change.
calc: progression A2: ClearSteps clears bits 2 to 11 of the word.

steps.text: Save and Exit writes each word as it stands: word 1 = 0x8001 and word 41 = 0x2002.
calc: progression A4: the written record is the loaded record after every server write, in order.

steps.text: Loading again turns word 41's bit 13 off and sets its bit 15 from its bit 1, so the offer is pending from an earlier game; word 1 stays done.
calc: progression A3: clear bits 13 and 14; if bit 1: set bit 15.
